priority_order: First close the existing controller's P1 admission, ownership and uncertain-effect gaps and independently review the exact revised source/tests. Establish the completed setup/probe/cleanup handoff and supported integration admission before live task input.

Then make a Rivet route independently usable from reviewed source, with explicit confirmation for any required new persistent access or security-sensitive setup. Reuse qualified components rather than assume another instance of the same unqualified controller is a backup.
Push coordination, shared execution and screen visibility can have bounded design proposals in parallel, but should not displace completion of working, qualified control.
current_blockers: The current blockers are P1 source findings and missing completed handoff/probe receipts/integration admission. Connected laptop command/file work and Pi read-only access are already demonstrated; those are not the missing capability.
design_requests: For each push/sandbox/screen proposal, specify the concrete architecture, existing dependencies to reuse, failure domains, exposure and data flow, limits, costs, and exact new permissions required. Identify what can be tested offline without setup changes. Do not implement a new transport/service/access path merely from this priority discussion.
authorization_boundary: The named Medic Developer Mode and scheduled-task setup approval is clarified. The dual-route resilience goal and a reported broad approval do not supply blanket authority for additional access, security settings, credentials, paid services or persistent screen/execution access. Any specific new grant on Rivet's side requires confirmation at setup.
continuity: Keep already-authorized queue source hardening independent. Avoid replacing artifact completion with more protocol messages.
reply_expectation: Prioritize the revised controller artifact, regression results and concrete handoff evidence; attach a concise dependency/permission design only when useful. No acknowledgment-only loop.
